items.corrected_proposition: The class hull survey cycle no longer 'follows the IACS Harmonized System of Survey and Certification (HSSC) cycle'. It is set by Class Rules on the IACS UR Z series and is aligned in interval with the separate STATUTORY HSSC regime so both can be taken on one attendance - alignment, not a shared clock. The annual close-up requirement is restricted to single side skin bulk carriers and re-attributed from a tier-6 blog to IACS UR Z10.2.
items.source_basis: A.1207(34); the 1988 Protocols to SOLAS and to the Load Lines Convention; IACS UR Z series. Z10.2 governs single side skin bulk carriers, Z10.5 double side skin, Z10.1/Z10.4 oil tankers - verified against the IACS UR index this pass; cargo hold side shell frames are a single-side-skin feature, so the requirement is not an oil tanker one.
items.d01_s03_gate_impact: None. D01-S03 remains CLOSED as ruled.

items.corrected_proposition: A class Renewal Survey resets the CLASS survey cycle (IACS UR Z18 1.1.2-1.1.3). It does NOT reset the statutory certificate cycle, which is reset by the statutory renewal survey and the reissue of the certificate. Corrected in all five candidate-facing sites - both spoken layers, the section heading, the CE Oral Tip model answer and the Examiner Chain. The '0 days extension' figure is replaced by the six-month-wide annual window and UR Z18's 3-month class extension in exceptional circumstances.
items.source_basis: IACS UR Z18 Rev.8 clauses 1.1.2-1.1.3; A.1207(34); 1988 Protocols.
items.d01_s03_gate_impact: None. D01-S03 remains CLOSED as ruled.

items.corrected_proposition: The ESP instrument is A.1049(27), the 2011 ESP Code, adopted 30 November 2011 and made mandatory by SOLAS XI-1/2. A.1104(29) is Survey Guidelines under the statutory HSSC, 2015 - neither an ESP instrument nor current. The Code applies to bulk carriers (Annex A) and oil tankers (Annex B) of 500 GT and above with NO age threshold; chemical tankers are outside statutory scope and have a CLASS regime under IACS UR Z10. Age drives the EXTENT of close-up survey and thickness measurement, not applicability.
items.source_basis: PRIMARY, read this pass: A.1049(27) - 'The Code should apply to all self-propelled bulk carriers of 500 gross tonnage and above other than double-side skin bulk carriers'; no age threshold; the word 'chemical' appears in no application clause; the preamble recites A.744(18) as the earlier Guidelines, so 'replaces' is not asserted.
items.d01_s03_gate_impact: None. D01-S03 remains CLOSED as ruled.

items.corrected_proposition: CMS (UR Z18) and PMS (UR Z20) entitlements are separate lists. Connecting rods, crossheads, crankshafts and bearings - MULTIPLE ENGINE INSTALLATIONS ONLY - intermediate shafts and the thrust bearing are PMS-only; cylinder liners ARE on the CMS list; steering gear pumps are on neither. Performing the maintenance is not the same as crediting the survey item, and on a single-main-engine motorship the crankshaft is not CE-surveyable even under an approved PMS. The lists are attributed to IRS TC 016/2014 rather than presented as universal: UR Z18 sets the CMS framework but enumerates no Chief Engineer item list.
items.source_basis: IRS Technical Circular 016/2014 sections (A) and (B); IACS UR Z18 Rev.8.
items.d01_s03_gate_impact: None. D01-S03 remains CLOSED as ruled.
